text:
Dear claims team,

I received your letter of 19 August 2026. It says a claim has been opened on my household contents policy with the date 11 August 2026, and it asks me a number of things. I want to answer clearly, because there seems to be a mix-up.

Nothing of mine was stolen on 11 August 2026, or on any other day. Nothing was taken from me while I was out and about, nothing was taken from me anywhere, and nothing I own was damaged. I have all my things. I never reported a theft to you or to anyone else, and I have no idea how this file came about. I asked Emma Zimmermann at Feldegg Management Ltd, who manage my building at Mühleweg 77 in St. Gallen, and she knows of nothing either.

You ask whether I had to do something at once, without waiting to hear from you, because there was a risk of more loss. No. There was no risk of anything and nothing that could not have waited. I did not have to act in a hurry at all.

You also ask whether anything has been repaired, cleaned or replaced since then. Nobody has repaired, cleaned or replaced anything for me, and I have not done any of that myself. There is nothing to repair.

Please close this file and send me a short written confirmation that there is no claim open in my name. I have been insured with you since 6 March 2023 and I have never made a claim, so I would rather this does not sit on my record.

Kind regards,
Henry Shaw
